title: DC Shopian declares official residence single-use plastic-free, urges wider adoption

ai.summary: Deputy Commissioner of Shopian declared his residence single-use plastic-free, launching a district-wide initiative under Swachh Bharat Mission 2.0 to reduce plastic use and improve waste management.

facts.claim: DC Shopian declared his official residence a Single-Use Plastic-Free Premises
facts.quote: A ‘SUP-Free’ signboard at the gate of Deputy Commissioner Shopian Charandeep Singh’s official residence sends out a message that the district administration wants residents, institutions and commercial establishments to take home: keeping single-use plastic out of everyday life.

facts.claim: The initiative is called ‘Swachh Shopian Janbhagidari Abhiyan’
facts.quote: Singh has declared his official residence a Single-Use Plastic-Free Premises, leading by example as the district administration launched the ‘Swachh Shopian Janbhagidari Abhiyan’ on Monday to promote responsible waste management and public participation in keeping the town clean.

facts.claim: The initiative is under Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban) 2.0
facts.quote: The initiative, launched under the Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban) 2.0, seeks to encourage households, government offices, commercial establishments and institutions to reduce the use of single-use plastics and adopt sustainable waste disposal practices.

facts.claim: The programme includes waste segregation and home composting
facts.quote: At the launch programme, the Deputy Commissioner demonstrated waste management practices at his residence, including source segregation and home composting. He deposited wet waste into a compost pit, showing how kitchen and garden waste can be converted into organic manure.

facts.claim: The programme features a four-bin waste segregation system
facts.quote: The programme also featured a demonstration of the four-bin waste segregation system, explaining the separation of household waste into wet waste, dry waste, sanitary waste and special-care waste, including batteries, expired medicines and chemical containers.

ai.background_note: The district administration of Shopian has launched a single-use plastic reduction initiative under Swachh Bharat Mission 2.0 to promote sustainable waste management practices.
